title: Triage Report (v1)
description: Canonical triage report (SPEC-015 R-1). The agent emits the report as a fenced triage-report JSON block during an operator-initiated triage run; incident-service validates it against this schema before storing. Every hypothesis and next step must be grounded in tool evidence or cited skills; next steps are advisory only (R3 does not execute anything).

incident_id.description: The incident this report belongs to.

summary.description: One-paragraph triage summary: what is happening, how severe, and why.

severity_assessment.description: Agent assessment of the incident severity based on gathered evidence.

source.description: Tool name or 'skills' — where the evidence came from.

evidence.description: Provenance references for the evidence gathered during triage.

hypotheses.description: Ranked likely causes, most likely first.

rationale.description: Why this step is recommended, grounded in evidence or cited guidance.

next_steps.description: Ranked advisory next steps; the platform does not execute them in R3.

skills_cited.description: skill_ids of team guidance consulted during triage.

session_id.description: The dedicated agent session the triage ran in (incident-<incident_id>).

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp (RFC 3339) when the report was captured.

generated_by.description: The operator who initiated the triage run.
